items.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Monk Rowe, Scottsdale, Arizona, April 16, 2000 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Yeah I got to play with Charlie Parker one time. I was with a band, the Charlie Fisk band... So we got up on the stand

ctx.x: He was a pretty good saxophone player.
He certainly was. You know who copied him and loved him was Charlie Parker. © Fillius Jazz Archive -6-
Yeah, right. He played some of those semi-classical things too pretty well. Didn’t you do a reunion thing with The Soft Winds fellas a number of years back?
